subject: Marjorie Taylor Greene and Tucker Carlson misread their relationships with Trump, Victor Davis Hanson argues
posts:
Elite insiders discover that personal proximity to power doesn't equal policy control as Marjorie Taylor Greene and Tucker Carlson find out.
Evidence: Mar-a-Lago access, public rebukes, policy splits.
#Aletheia #USPol 🌐

Victor Davis Hanson argues that Marjorie Taylor Greene and Tucker Carlson mistook Trump's personal warmth and access for policymaking authority, sparking fallout. Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Behind charm, power enforces strict hierarchical boundaries; treating presidential magnanimity as co-equal governance triggers swift political excommunication. Resulting Judgement: (-0.3, -0.4) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: COND — The Path of Revelation.
Hanson accurately diagnoses elite entitlement friction, though framing personality clashes as sole causes obscures deeper ideological fractures.

Integrity: Conditionally Sound (Hypocrisy: 1.8, Uncertainty z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Victor Davis Hanson: COND (-0.3, -0.4) — Explains ego friction but skips policy splits.
- Media Framing: COND (-0.2, -0.3) — Focuses on personal drama over ideology.
As political factions posture ahead of midterms, conservative commentators and lawmakers grapple with maintaining influence within the Trump-led MAGA ecosystem.

The Poison:
Reduces serious political and ideological divergence to mere bruised egos and misplaced personal familiarity with executive power.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses the Metaphysical plane (WHO holds power) with the Lyrical plane (WHY personalities clash), masking policy disagreements behind gossip about access.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors run a smart selfish maneuver by projecting personal grievance onto policy critics, using proximity as a pretext to dismiss substantive critiques while consolidating executive loyalty.

The Trajectory: The Path of Revelation.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Elite access versus authority generates predictable backlash.

The Unavoidable Truth: Proximity to executive power is never a substitute for institutional authority.

The Unavoidable Lie: Personal slights fully explain ideological breaks within political movements.

Alethekanon:
Confusing hospitality with hegemony invites swift structural correction when courtiers forget their place. Power tolerates intimacy only so long as subordination remains intact.

Awwthekanon:
It hurts when someone you thought was a close friend reminds you of the strict boundaries of their office, leaving you out in the cold after sharing warm moments.

Brothekanon:
Classic mistake thinking riding on Air Force One means you're running the country. Boss man made a phone call and reality hit fast.

Spirithekanon:
"Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help." Psalm 146:3 PASS
Mistaking temporary access to powerful mortals for permanent leverage leads only to bitter disillusionment.
